host: Intel(R) Core(TM) 5 210H, 12 threads, Linux, Node v22.22.2; margins from six runs: wall and heap budgets (enforce: local) hold on this host only; GitHub runners check the ci measures

fleet.mount.ms.reason: First render of #/fleet with every agent stored: rows, run names, facets and the virtual list.

fleet.mount.commits.reason: Mounting commits once; more means a state cascade on first paint.

fleet.mount.dom_elements.reason: The list is virtualized (§5.4): DOM grows with the viewport, never with the fleet.

fleet.mount.row_renders.reason: Rows rendered on mount: a screenful plus overscan.

fleet.mount.heap_bytes.reason: Heap the mounted screen keeps beyond the stored agents: derived rows, facets and the DOM.

fleet.filter.row_renders.reason: Rows rendered by one State filter change.

fleet.filter.dom_mutations.reason: Filtering through the State picker: its value, the count and the rows that change; the picker draws its value and badge beside the list.

fleet.filter.ms.reason: One filter change over 5,000 agents, then a frame. Noise 25%: three later runs spread 20.8%.

fleet.scroll.row_renders.reason: Rows rendered by a 12-row scroll: only rows that came into view (rows are memoized).

fleet.scroll.dom_mutations.reason: DOM mutations for one 12-row scroll step.

fleet.scroll.ms.reason: One 12-row scroll step and its frame.

fleet.delta.commits.reason: One changed agent row is one React commit.

fleet.delta.row_renders.reason: Rows re-rendered by one changed agent: today every row on screen, since fleetRows rebuilds row objects.

fleet.delta.dom_mutations.reason: DOM mutations for one changed agent: the changed row's pill only.

fleet.delta.ms.reason: One get_agent reply applied and committed: the fleet rows, run names and facets are rebuilt over 5,000 agents (O(n log n)).

conversation.mount.ms.reason: First render of a stored 20,000-entry transcript: tool pairing, rows, offsets and the measured list.

conversation.mount.commits.reason: Mount commits: the render and the viewport measure.

conversation.mount.dom_elements.reason: The full-height chat: speaker marks, folded tool rows with Copy, the find bar, jump to latest and the pinned composer (§5.5).

conversation.mount.row_renders.reason: Messages rendered on mount: those in view plus overscan.

conversation.mount.heap_bytes.reason: Heap the mounted conversation keeps beyond the stored entries: rows, parts, offsets and the DOM.

conversation.scroll.row_renders.reason: Messages rendered by a 600 px scroll step.

conversation.scroll.dom_mutations.reason: DOM mutations for one 600 px scroll step.

conversation.scroll.ms.reason: One 600 px scroll step: offsets are rebuilt over every row.

conversation.delta.commits.reason: One streamed text delta is one React commit.

conversation.delta.row_renders.reason: A streamed delta re-renders only its live tail, never committed rows.

conversation.delta.dom_mutations.reason: A streamed delta changes only the live tail's text.

conversation.delta.ms.reason: One text delta applied by aether-reduce and committed with a 20,000-entry transcript on screen.

conversation.commit.row_renders.reason: Messages re-rendered when a message commits: every row in view, since entryRows rebuilds row objects.

conversation.commit.ms.reason: One committed agent.message: mergeEntries sorts and entryRows rebuilds 20,000 rows (O(n log n)).

dag.mount.ms.reason: First render of a 2,000-item DAG through its layered layout (run inline) and first paint.

dag.mount.canvas_frames.reason: One painted frame once the layout lands.

dag.mount.dom_elements.reason: DOM of the DAG screen; most of it is the canvas's accessible node list, one button per item (not virtualized).

dag.mount.heap_bytes.reason: Heap the mounted DAG keeps beyond the stored graph: data, layout, scene and DOM (React dev build).

dag.select.layouts.reason: Selecting an item never lays out again (§5.4).

dag.select.dom_mutations.reason: Selecting a node also fills the detail card and raises the legend entry of its kind.

dag.select.ms.reason: Selecting a held-up item from the overview and its frame.

dag.delta.layouts.reason: A state change never lays out again (§5.4): its budget is 0.

dag.delta.dom_mutations.reason: DOM mutations for one item's state change.

dag.delta.ms.reason: One item's state change: DAG data, critical path, held list and the 2,000-button node list are rebuilt.

deltas.react_commits.fixture: 10 s: 3 streams x 40 deltas/s, 15 commits, 200 row updates
deltas.react_commits.reason: Store updates batch to one commit per frame (§5.4): at most one per frame with a visible change, of 600.

deltas.row_renders.fixture: 10 s: 3 streams x 40 deltas/s, 15 commits, 200 row updates
deltas.row_renders.reason: Messages rendered over the whole load: the live tail per delta, plus the rows in view when the on-screen agent commits.

deltas.dom_mutations.fixture: 10 s: 3 streams x 40 deltas/s, 15 commits, 200 row updates
deltas.dom_mutations.reason: DOM mutations over the whole load.

deltas.frame_p50_ms.fixture: 10 s: 3 streams x 40 deltas/s, 15 commits, 200 row updates
deltas.frame_p50_ms.reason: Median frame: the frame's ops applied, committed and rendered.

deltas.frame_p95_ms.fixture: 10 s: 3 streams x 40 deltas/s, 15 commits, 200 row updates
deltas.frame_p95_ms.reason: 95th percentile frame: frames where a message commits or another agent's event rebuilds the rows.

bundle.total_bytes.reason: The overhaul's screens: the GitHub overview with charts and a graph, the home dashboard, the graph canvas, the kit pickers and the draft store.

bundle.js_bytes.reason: As bundle.total_bytes: the overhaul's screens, canvases and pickers.

bundle.css_bytes.reason: One token system, the kit's pickers, combos, switches and segments, chart and canvas styles, the chat and the dashboard.

bundle.initial_bytes.reason: The first screen carries the kit (pickers, model picker, draft store), the navigation rail with icons and the home dashboard.

bundle.largest_js_bytes.reason: The entry chunk: the kit, the navigation, the store and the home dashboard; screens stay lazy chunks.
